name: Great Tree
description: The **Great Tree** serves as the metaphorical source of the sons and daughters chosen by the Mother's Prayer. Each chosen individual is described as fruit produced by the tree; if one does not fulfill their role, another bud may eventually grow. Gerk is described as a son or child of the Great Tree, which apparently has multiple sons and daughters besides him. Those who join Gerk become metaphorical brothers and sisters to him and relatives of the Great Tree's other children.

log.summary: The **Great Tree** serves as the metaphorical source of the sons and daughters chosen by the **Mother's Prayer**. Each chosen individual is described as fruit produced by the tree, and if one fails to fulfill their role, another bud may eventually grow in their place. **Gerk** is identified as one such son or child of the Great Tree, but he is not alone—the tree apparently has multiple sons and daughters besides him. Those who choose to join Gerk in his calling are drawn into the same symbolic family, becoming metaphorical brothers and sisters to him and relatives of the Great Tree's other children.
